headword: {迷走神経|めいそうしんけい}

definitions.explanation: The long cranial nerve that runs from the brain down through the neck and chest to the abdomen, controlling heart rate, digestion, and other automatic functions.

examples.japanese: {迷走神経|めいそうしんけい}は{脳|のう}から{出|で}ている。
examples.english: The vagus nerve comes out of the brain.

examples.japanese: {迷走神経|めいそうしんけい}が{心臓|しんぞう}の{働|はたら}きを{調節|ちょうせつ}している。
examples.english: The vagus nerve regulates the working of the heart.

examples.japanese: {採血|さいけつ}のときに{気|き}を{失|うしな}うのは、{迷走神経|めいそうしんけい}{反射|はんしゃ}によるものが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Fainting during a blood draw is often caused by a vagus nerve reflex.

notes:
{迷走|めいそう} (wandering, straying) + {神経|しんけい} (nerve) — named for the long, wandering course the nerve takes through the body, matching the Latin sense of "vagus".

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {迷走神経|めいそうしんけい}{反射|はんしゃ}: vagal reflex
- {迷走神経|めいそうしんけい}を{刺激|しげき}する: to stimulate the vagus nerve
- {迷走神経|めいそうしんけい}の{働|はたら}き: the action of the vagus nerve

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自律神経|じりつしんけい}: autonomic nervous system — the larger system the vagus nerve belongs to
- {視神経|ししんけい}: optic nerve — another named cranial nerve
